verdict.rationale: Apify runs a marketplace (Apify Store) of 64,279 Actors, including ready-made scrapers such as a TikTok scraper. The docs state you can run both your own Actors and Actors from Apify Store, with a JS client example that calls the prebuilt 'apify/web-scraper' Actor and waits for its results. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of running Store scrapers; the community comments are general praise and don't address the marketplace.
